name: Lumentum Holdings Inc.
blurb: Lumentum makes the lasers, optical chips, and components that go into the high-speed transceivers wiring AI data centres together. Spun out of JDSU in 2015, it spent its first decade as a 3D-sensing and telecom-optics supplier of moderate growth. The AI-cluster build-out has remade it into one of the principal upstream beneficiaries of hyperscaler capex, alongside Coherent Corp.
recent: Q1 fiscal-2026 set record revenue, with management citing AI-driven demand and an order book that runs into 2027. In March 2026 Nvidia announced a roughly $2 billion strategic investment paired with multi-year purchase commitments for co-packaged-optics components. The company joined the S&P 500 in March 2026; shares have surged on AI demand, leaving the stock at a forward P/E in the 60s, materially above peers.
